stars.note: More minutes with Aday Mara and Jaylin Williams out.
stars.why: Gilgeous-Alexander missed Sunday at Miami with a neck strain and a lower back contusion, his first absence of the season, and Oklahoma City had not filed today's injury report this morning, so his status at Indiana is not posted. If he plays on this thin roster, he is the offense; the Thunder dressed only nine players Sunday.

Kawhi Leonard and RJ Barrett are both out again, so Toronto's offense runs through Barnes against Milwaukee; he played 37 minutes Friday in his second game back from a groin strain. Collin Murray-Boyles is probable to return from the concussion protocol, which helps the frontcourt but does not cut into Barnes' role.

Avdija came back from a foot contusion Saturday and played 36 minutes, and Ja Morant, Shaedon Sharpe and Vit Krejci are all still out for Portland. He is not on today's injury report, so he stays the Blazers' main creator at Philadelphia. His game has a 231.5-point total.

Jerome returned Saturday from three games out with hip soreness and started for 27 minutes. Memphis is without Cameron Boozer, Jerami Grant, GG Jackson and Scotty Pippen Jr. at Charlotte, so there is room for his minutes to climb back toward 30.

Phoenix has spread its minutes across the bench lately, but Booker is the exception at 37 and 38 minutes in two of his last three games. Mark Williams is out after shoulder surgery and New Orleans is without Dejounte Murray and Bennedict Mathurin, while Zion Williamson is probable. His game has a 233.5-point total.

guide: Pair two or three stars with two or three scrubs, then fill the middle. The scrubs are what make the stars fit under the $50,000 cap.
